ZAgent is powered by agentic AI to enhance the capabilities of the AI virtual assistant that is dedicated to troubleshooting multistep tasks and answering complex questions. The Risk Analysis AI agent is designed to enhance your organization’s ability to identify and scope risk within your Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) environment by using Risk360.
